_comment: Public regulatory documents this library is validated against. The PDFs are not committed — fetch them with scripts/fetch_validation_corpus.py and compare the sha256 to confirm you have the same bytes.

documents.title: Clinical Pharmacology and Biopharmaceutics Review(s), NDA 209529
documents.rationale: A full CP review containing a dedicated renal impairment assessment, so a skill's findings can be compared against what an FDA reviewer actually wrote about the same study.

documents.title: Clinical Pharmacology and Biopharmaceutics Review(s), NDA 215859
documents.rationale: Carries renal dosing conclusions tied to eGFR bands, which is exactly the reconciliation a review skill claims to perform.

documents.title: Clinical Pharmacology and Biopharmaceutics Review(s), NDA 202293
documents.rationale: Contains renal impairment PK and PD figures, giving a case where exposure and effect must be reconciled rather than read off.

documents.title: Clinical Pharmacology and Biopharmaceutics Review(s), NDA 204671
documents.rationale: Combines renal impairment with a co-administration dosing consequence, so a skill has to keep two threads straight.

documents.title: Clinical Pharmacology and Biopharmaceutics Review(s), NDA 207923
documents.rationale: Held back from the first scoring round as an unseen document for the independent human trial, so stage 2 is not judging findings it has already read.
